    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(humanoidRootPart, tweenInfo, {
        CFrame = CFrame.new(offsetPosition)
    })
    
    statusLabel.Text = "🚀 Teleporting to " .. itemName .. "..."
    tween:Play()
    
    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        statusLabel.Text = "✅ Teleported to " .. itemName .. "!"
        task.wait(1)
        if statusLabel and statusLabel.Parent then
            statusLabel.Text = "Ready to teleport"
        end
    end)
    
    return true
end

-- Function to teleport to specific item
local function teleportToSpecificItem(itemName)
    if not canTeleport then 
        statusLabel.Text = "⏳ Teleport on cooldown..."
        return 
    end
    
    canTeleport = false
    
    local character = Player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        statusLabel.Text = "❌ Character not found!"
        canTeleport = true
        return
    end

    local itemsFound = {}
    local itemData = targetItems[itemName] or {quantity = 1}
    
    statusLabel.Text = "🔍 Finding " .. itemName .. "..."
    
    -- Search through workspace for specific item
    for _, item in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if item.Name == itemName then
            local position = nil
            
            -- Get item position based on type
            if item:IsA("BasePart") then
                position = item.Position
            elseif item:IsA("Model") then
                local primaryPart = item.PrimaryPart or item:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
                if primaryPart then
                    position = primaryPart.Position
                end
            end
            
            if position then
                table.insert(itemsFound, {item = item, position = position})
            end
        end
    end
    
    if #itemsFound == 0 then
        statusLabel.Text = "❌ No " .. itemName .. " found!"
        canTeleport = true
        return
    end
    
    -- Find closest item
    local playerPosition = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    local closestItem = nil
    local closestDistance = math.huge
    
    for _, itemInfo in pairs(itemsFound) do
        local distance = (playerPosition - itemInfo.position).Magnitude
        if distance < closestDistance then
            closestDistance = distance
            closestItem = itemInfo
        end
    end
    
    if closestItem then
        teleportToPosition(closestItem.position, itemName)
    else
        statusLabel.Text = "❌ Could not find accessible " .. itemName
    end
    
    -- Reset cooldown
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(COOLDOWN)
        canTeleport = true
    end)
end

-- Function to auto-collect mode (teleport to multiple items)
local function autoCollectItems()
    if not canTeleport then 
        statusLabel.Text = "⏳ Auto-collect on cooldown..."
        return 
    end
    
    if not AUTO_COLLECT_MODE then
        statusLabel.Text = "❌ Auto-collect mode disabled"
        return
    end
    
    canTeleport = false
    
    local character = Player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        statusLabel.Text = "❌ Character not found!"
        canTeleport = true
        return
    end

    local itemQueue = {}
    local itemsCounted = {}
    
    statusLabel.Text = "🎯 Building teleport queue..."
    
    -- Initialize counters
    for itemName, _ in pairs(targetItems) do
        itemsCounted[itemName] = 0
    end
    
    -- Build queue of items to collect
    for _, item in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if targetItems[item.Name] then
            local itemName = item.Name
            local targetCount = targetItems[itemName].quantity
            
            -- Check if we need more of this item
            if targetCount == -1 or itemsCounted[itemName] < targetCount then
                local position = nil
                
                if item:IsA("BasePart") then
                    position = item.Position
                elseif item:IsA("Model") then
                    local primaryPart = item.PrimaryPart or item:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
                    if primaryPart then
                        position = primaryPart.Position
                    end
                end
                
                if position then
                    table.insert(itemQueue, {
                        name = itemName,
                        position = position,
                        item = item
                    })
                    itemsCounted[itemName] = itemsCounted[itemName] + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if #itemQueue == 0 then
        statusLabel.Text = "❌ No target items found!"
        canTeleport = true
        return
    end
    
    -- Sort queue by distance from player
    local playerPosition = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    table.sort(itemQueue, function(a, b)
        local distA = (playerPosition - a.position).Magnitude
        local distB = (playerPosition - b.position).Magnitude
        return distA < distB
    end)
    
    statusLabel.Text = "🚀 Starting auto-collect (" .. #itemQueue .. " items)..."
    
    -- Teleport to first item (you can extend this to teleport through the queue)
    if itemQueue[1] then
        teleportToPosition(itemQueue[1].position, itemQueue[1].name)
    end
    
    -- Reset cooldown
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(COOLDOWN * 2) -- Longer cooldown for auto-collect
        canTeleport = true
    end)
end

-- Function to discover new items in workspace
local function discoverNewItems()
    if not canDiscover then return end
    canDiscover = false
    
    discoveredItems = {}
    local newItemsFound = 0
    
    statusLabel.Text = "🔍 Discovering new items..."
    
    -- Scan workspace for any items not in our target list
    for _, item in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Model") then
            local itemName = item.Name
            -- Skip if it's already in our target list or if it's a common non-item object
            if not targetItems[itemName] and not discoveredItems[itemName] then
                -- Filter out common game objects that aren't items
                local skipNames = {
                    "Baseplate", "SpawnLocation", "Camera", "Lighting", "Terrain",
                    "StarterGui", "StarterPack", "StarterPlayer", "ReplicatedStorage",
                    "ServerStorage", "Teams", "Workspace", "Players", "Part", "Block",
                    "Wedge", "CornerWedge", "Cylinder", "Ball", "Seat", "VehicleSeat",
                    "TrussPart", "WedgePart", "CornerWedgePart", "Model", "Folder",
                    "Configuration", "IntValue", "StringValue", "BoolValue", "NumberValue"
                }
                
                local shouldSkip = false
                for _, skipName in pairs(skipNames) do
                    if itemName == skipName or itemName:find("Part") or itemName:find("Block") then
                        shouldSkip = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                
                if not shouldSkip and itemName ~= "" and #itemName > 1 then
                    discoveredItems[itemName] = (discoveredItems[itemName] or 0) + 1
                    newItemsFound = newItemsFound + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if newItemsFound > 0 then
        statusLabel.Text = "🆕 Found " .. newItemsFound .. " new item types!"
        -- Add discovered items to available items for display
        for itemName, count in pairs(discoveredItems) do
            if not targetItems[itemName] then -- Only add if truly new
                targetItems[itemName] = {quantity = 1, category = "Miscellaneous"}
            end
            availableItems[itemName] = count
        end
        updateItemDisplay()
    else
        statusLabel.Text = "✅ No new items found."
    end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(1)
        canDiscover = true
    end)
end

-- Function to scan workspace for items
function scanWorkspaceItems()
    if not canScan then return end
    canScan = false
    
    availableItems = {}
    itemPositions = {}
    local totalItems = 0
    
    statusLabel.Text = "🔍 Scanning workspace..."
    
    -- Look in workspace and common item containers
    local function scanContainer(container, containerName)
        for _, item in pairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
            if targetItems[item.Name] then
                availableItems[item.Name] = (availableItems[item.Name] or 0) + 1
                totalItems = totalItems + 1
                
                -- Store position for teleportation
                local position = nil
                if item:IsA("BasePart") then
                    position = item.Position
                elseif item:IsA("Model") then
                    local primaryPart = item.PrimaryPart or item:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
                    if primaryPart then
                        position = primaryPart.Position
                    end
                end
                
                if position then
                    if not itemPositions[item.Name] then
                        itemPositions[item.Name] = {}
                    end
                    table.insert(itemPositions[item.Name], position)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Scan main workspace
    scanContainer(workspace, "Workspace")
    
    -- Scan common item container names
    local itemContainers = workspace:FindFirstChild("Items") or workspace:FindFirstChild("ItemSpawns") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Collectibles")
    if itemContainers then
        scanContainer(itemContainers, "Items Container")
    end
    
    statusLabel.Text = "📊 Found " .. totalItems .. " target items"
    updateItemDisplay()
    
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(1)

    end)
end

-- Create a waypoint system for tracking teleported locations
local waypointHistory = {}
local maxWaypoints = 5

local function addWaypoint(position, itemName)
    table.insert(waypointHistory, 1, {
        position = position,
        name = itemName,
        timestamp = tick()
    })
    
    -- Keep only the last maxWaypoints
    while #waypointHistory > maxWaypoints do
        table.remove(waypointHistory)
    end
end

-- Function to teleport back to previous location
local function teleportToPreviousWaypoint()
    if #waypointHistory > 1 then -- Skip current location
        local waypoint = waypointHistory[2]
        if waypoint then
            teleportToPosition(waypoint.position, "Previous: " .. waypoint.name)
        end
    else
        statusLabel.Text = "❌ No previous locations"
    end
end

-- Override teleportToPosition to add waypoint tracking
local originalTeleportToPosition = teleportToPosition
teleportToPosition = function(position, itemName)
    addWaypoint(position, itemName)
    return originalTeleportToPosition(position, itemName)
end

print("📍 Waypoint system tracks your last 5 locations")

scripts.title: 99 Nights MOBILE SUPPORT
scripts.features:
Visuals (ESP)
Player ESP: Draws a box around other players.
Chest ESP: Draws a box around all item chests.
Player ESP Opacity: A slider to control the transparency of the player ESP boxes for a custom visual experience.


Player & Movement
Fly: A  flight mode with an adjustable speed slider.
Noclip: A manual toggle to walk through walls and objects when not flying.
Walk Speed: A slider to adjust your character's walking speed.
Jump Power: A slider to adjust your character's jump height.
Blink Key:  teleport a short distance forward.


Teleportation
Teleport to Player: Teleport to specific player
Teleport to Campsite: A button for an instant  tween to the main campsite.
Teleport to Nearest Chest: A button to instantly tween to the nearest chest.


Item & Objective Management
Bring All Items: A button to teleport all  items on the map directly to you.
Bring Selected Item: dropdown menu of all available items on the map, allowing you to bring all items of a specific type.
Bring Lost Child: dropdown menu of all "Lost Child" NPCs on the map

Automation
Auto Eat:  automatically consumes a random food item from the ground every 4 seconds to maintain your hunger.
